bugs.title: [BUG] App API - /api/* data plane - All endpoints return HTTP 500 while SPA shells 200
bugs.description: Every first-party `app.gas.cash/api/*` call in the logged-in network audit returned HTTP 500 with a uniform `code:internal` envelope. SPA document shells still load 200. Privy auth is healthy. Soft-fail UI copy matches these 500s 1:1 across Mini Mart, Live pumps, Leaderboard, ATM, and Inventory.
testData: Account: Privy storageState session (LOG OUT / SET USERNAME visible; no login wall)
Uniform body: {"ok":false,"kind":"error","code":"internal","message":"Something went wrong. Try again.","requestId":"hkg1::…"}
precondition: Logged-in Privy session valid at start and end of capture
Geolocation granted (synthetic HCMC coords)
No txs signed; money-safe journey only
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash while authenticated.
Navigate across shells: `/`, `/garage`, `/mini-mart`, `/atm` (+ My Stakes), `/leaderboard`, `/mileage`, `/dealership`, `/proof`, `/chopshop`, `/pitstop`.
Observe soft-fail banners and Network panel for `app.gas.cash/api/*`.
Observe that document navigations return 200 while every `/api/*` returns 500.
bugs.actual: All `https://app.gas.cash/api/*` calls return HTTP 500 with shared `code:internal` + `hkg1::` requestIds. UI shows soft-fails (shop, pumps, leaderboard, Robinhood Chain, inventory, blank balances). SPA shells still 200. Privy 2xx.
bugs.expected: Authed `/api/*` business endpoints return 2xx with data; soft-fail banners absent when the session is valid. SPA and data plane should both be healthy for a logged-in user.

Map / Live pumps — Could not load/read the pumps

bugs.title: [BUG] ATM - Robinhood Chain / POST /api/rpc - Storm of 500s and Could not read Robinhood Chain
bugs.description: `POST /api/rpc` dominates the failure volume (176 calls: 152×500 + 24 aborted) with bursts up to 12 requests / 3s on ATM / My Stakes. UI shows “Could not read Robinhood Chain” / “My stakes, could not read”.
testData: Endpoint: POST /api/rpc — 176 calls in audit session
Account: Privy storageState (authed); no stake tx signed
precondition: Logged-in session with ATM shell reachable
Money-safe: open My Stakes / stake CTA only; do not sign or send
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash/atm while authenticated.
Open My Stakes (and stake CTA if shown).
Watch Network for `POST /api/rpc` volume and status.
Observe the ATM soft-fail copy for Robinhood Chain / My Stakes.
bugs.actual: ATM shows “Could not read Robinhood Chain” (and My Stakes could not read). `POST /api/rpc` hammers with 500s/aborts; each navigation re-issues. Failing calls still take ~300–400ms each, amplifying perceived latency.
bugs.expected: Chain reads succeed (or fail once with clear backoff). Soft-fail distinguishes RPC proxy 500 vs empty stakes. No 10+/3s retry storm on a known failure.

bugs.title: [BUG] Layout chrome - Global fetches - me/stats, scratch tiers, claims/live, lineup refetch on every route
bugs.description: Shared layout chrome re-fetches the same endpoints on almost every client navigation even when unrelated to the page. Combined with the /api/* 500 outage, duplicates amplify load and “Try again” latency without recovering data.
testData: Observed counts (single logged-in journey): GET /api/me/stats ×38, GET /api/games/scratch/tiers ×38, GET /api/lineup ×34, GET /api/claims/live ×27
Burst: me/stats & scratch tiers up to 3/3s; lineup up to 5/3s
precondition: Authenticated session
DevTools Network open; filter XHR/fetch to app.gas.cash/api
steps: Load the home map while authenticated.
Client-navigate through garage, mini-mart, atm, leaderboard, mileage, dealership.
Compare request counts for `/api/me/stats`, `/api/games/scratch/tiers`, `/api/claims/live`, `/api/lineup` across phases.
Observe that unrelated pages still re-burst the same chrome endpoints.
bugs.actual: Global chrome endpoints refetch on nearly every route. Unrelated pages still pull scratch tiers, live pumps, and lineup. During outage this multiplies 500 traffic without user recovery.
bugs.expected: Layout data is cached/shared across routes (SWR/query cache or equivalent). No per-nav re-burst of me/stats, scratch tiers, claims/live, and lineup when data is fresh or already known-failed with backoff.

bugs.title: [BUG] Auth bootstrap - POST /api/auth/sync - Returns 500 while Privy session is healthy
bugs.description: `POST /api/auth/sync` returned 500 (×13) throughout the audit while Privy (`auth.privy.io`) stayed fully 2xx. User remains Privy-logged-in (no login wall) but app auth bootstrap / data plane stays broken — suggests regional/backend or auth-context bug after Privy sync.
testData: Privy: GET apps + POST sessions + CF challenge — 27× 2xx
UI chrome: SET USERNAME, LOG OUT, portfolio shell present
Session end: Privy token + refresh still present
precondition: Valid Privy storageState reused
Confirm no login wall before probing /api/auth/sync
steps: Load https://app.gas.cash with a valid Privy session.
Confirm Privy network calls succeed (2xx).
Filter Network for `POST /api/auth/sync` across navigations.
Observe app soft-fails and whether sync recovers on retry.
bugs.actual: `POST /api/auth/sync` repeatedly 500s with the same internal envelope. Privy remains healthy; user stays logged-in in Privy chrome but app APIs do not recover. Sync re-fires on navigation despite a stable Privy session.
bugs.expected: When Privy session is valid, `/api/auth/sync` succeeds and establishes app auth context so subsequent `/api/*` reads work. Do not re-sync on every nav when already synced.

evidence.alt: Authed soft-fail while Privy session held (shop)
Week-1 smoke Mini Mart shell — authed, shop load fail

bugs.title: [BUG] Mini Mart - SKU chrome - Items look purchasable with blank prices while shop load fails
bugs.description: When Mini Mart fails to load (`Could not load the shop`), SKU chrome still renders with blank/`-` prices and live-looking qty steppers (`− 0 +`). Keys, crowbars, insurance, scratchers, Alarm-class items list without a clear Coming Soon banner (Crowbar T3 correctly DROP ONLY). Risk of confusing purchasability during API outage.
testData: Prices shown as `-` / blank; qty steppers visible
precondition: Authenticated session
Shop APIs failing (same window as full /api/* 500 outage) or shop load error banner visible
Money-safe: do not purchase
steps: Open https://app.gas.cash/mini-mart while authenticated.
Confirm “Could not load the shop” (or equivalent) soft-fail.
Scan SKU rows: keys, crowbars, insurance, scratchers, Alarm-class.
Observe price cells and qty steppers while load is failed.
bugs.actual: Shop error banner shows, but SKUs still render with blank/`-` prices and interactive-looking `− 0 +` steppers. Purchasability is ambiguous during load fail; limited SKUs lack a clear Coming Soon treatment (except Crowbar T3 DROP ONLY).
bugs.expected: On shop load failure, disable purchase controls and/or hide price/qty chrome until prices load. Non-purchasable / coming-soon SKUs should be explicitly labeled so they do not look buyable.
